title: Perfect acceptance gives signed value one
statement: Let $T$ be a finite random-seed tester and let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube. If the tester's acceptance probability on $f$ is $1$, then the average over its seed distribution of the signed value of its selected check on $f$ is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a sign tester with a finite seed type and seed probability law
$f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
The acceptance probability of $T$ on $f$ equals $1$
